description: IM3 Open Source Data Center Atlas is a data set deposited in DOE Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) Repository by its authors Kendall Mongird, Chris Vernon. IM3 Open Source Data Center Atlas Description This dataset contains locations of existing data center facilities in the United States. Data center locations were derived from OpenStreetMap (OSM), a crowd-sourced database. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29).
